Finn bringing cider is unrelated to villagers wandering in as the sun rose.
Stacking cider crates has no bearing on the baker's identity or age.
Finn's action with cider crates has no bearing on relative heights of Fay and Yara.

Both describe the crowd growing, so a slowly growing queue supports the idea of more villagers arriving as time passed.
